requirements: R1: Replace simulated async delays and mock streaming stubs in Internal.svelte with genuine backend chat API integration (/api/chat or backend service) maintaining real response handling
R2: Implement robust loading, empty, error, and presentation states without hardcoded mock responses or fake timer simulacra

slices.title: Integrate genuine backend chat API and remove simulated delay stubs in Internal.svelte
slices.jtbd: When implementing real AI assistant messaging in Internal.svelte, I want to replace simulated setTimeout delays and mock responses with actual backend API calls, so that the assistant provides authentic live regulatory responses with complete error and state management.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user submits a question in the AI regulatory assistant, When the request is dispatched, Then a real HTTP POST call is made to /api/chat rather than relying on setTimeout or mock generators.
Given the assistant API call is in progress or fails, When network latency or an HTTP error occurs, Then proper loading indicators or graceful diagnostic error banners are rendered without falling back to hardcoded mock text.
Given unit and component test suites run against Internal.svelte, When inspecting source and runtime assertions, Then no D010 simulated delay stubs or D008 tautological mock checks are detected and all assistant queries correctly reflect live API state.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 0 simulated delay stubs and 100% genuine API response coverage
